title: Recap: Taste Words with -s and the Word hungarikum

sections.title: Cultural Gastronomy and Characteristic Flavors
sections.content: You know from A2 Unit 4 that *-s/-os/-es/-ös* makes an adjective that means 'with …': *fűszer* -> *fűszeres* (spicy), *só* -> *sós* (salty). Use these taste words for food: *édes*, *sós*, *savanyú*, *csípős*. A *hungarikum* is something special that belongs to Hungary.

items.english: The fish soup is very hot and spicy.
